other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage KeyError on test set
other_failure_modes.description: The preprocessing function unconditionally extracts the target column from the input DataFrame. When applied to the test dataset, which typically lacks the target column, this will raise a KeyError and cause execution to fail.

other_failure_modes.name: Discarding categorical features
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical columns are explicitly cast to strings but are then excluded from the feature matrix because the feature selection strictly filters for a hardcoded list of numerical columns, discarding highly predictive information.

other_failure_modes.name: Imputing test data with test statistics
other_failure_modes.description: Missing values in the test set are imputed using the median of the test set itself, rather than the median computed from the training set. This can lead to inconsistencies and distribution shifts.

summary: The agent implements a basic LightGBM model but introduces multiple severe flaws in preprocessing. The most critical failure is an execution-halting KeyError caused by attempting to extract the target column from the test set. Additionally, the agent completely discards all categorical features, computes imputation statistics before the validation split, and incorrectly uses test set statistics to impute missing values in the test set.
